host.sanitized: all temp paths replaced by $P (mktemp -d); canary scripts append to $P/canary.log and attempt /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1 connections

environmentNote: all probe commands run with GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null so results do not depend on ambient user config (the dev machine's real global config declares filter.lfs.process and hijacked an early fixture commit — evidence that user-global filters are a live attack surface)

candidates.name: git worktree add --detach + -c overrides + preflight filter-attribute scan
candidates.conclusion: provably no-external-program once preflight proves no in-tree path carries a filter attribute

candidates.name: worktree add --no-checkout + read-tree + checkout-index -f -a (plumbing fill)
candidates.conclusion: checkout-index still executes smudge filters (P7); no benefit over candidate 1

candidates.name: git archive <sha> | tar -x
candidates.conclusion: archive executes smudge filters (P8) and diverges from checkout semantics (export-subst rewrites content, export-ignore drops files)

probes.question: does git worktree add run the post-checkout hook from repo core.hooksPath?
probes.reproduce:
cd $P/repo && git config core.hooksPath $P/hooks   # $P/hooks/post-checkout writes canary
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD

probes.question: does a repo-config smudge filter run during worktree add when .gitattributes declares it?
probes.reproduce:
printf '*.flt filter=evil\n' > .gitattributes   # committed
git config filter.evil.smudge $P/smudge.sh && git config filter.evil.clean $P/clean.sh
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD
probes.result: EXECUTED — smudge canary written; filters are the one entry point -c cannot wildcard-disable (driver name unknown)

probes.question: does an empty per-name override (-c filter.<name>.smudge=) work when the name IS known?
probes.reproduce: cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git -c filter.evil.smudge= -c filter.evil.clean= worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD
probes.result: NOT executed — viable only as fallback with enumerated names, not as the primary defense

probes.question: filter attribute declared but driver config absent?
probes.reproduce:
# .gitattributes: *.flt filter=missing (committed), no filter.missing.* config
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD && cat $P/wt/f.flt
probes.result: no execution; checkout emits the raw blob — correctness unprovable, basis for fail-closed CapabilityUnavailable

probes.question: does git check-attr --source=<sha> read attributes from the commit tree (not the working tree)?
probes.reproduce:
cd $P/repo && echo '*.flt -filter' > .gitattributes   # working tree contradicts commit
git check-attr --source=<sha> filter -- y.flt
git check-attr filter -- y.flt
probes.result: --source reports 'evil' (commit tree); working-tree read reports 'unset' — preflight must use --source

probes.question: does .git/info/attributes participate in the attribute stack seen by check-attr?
probes.reproduce:
echo '*.flt filter=evil' > $P/repo/.git/info/attributes
cd $P/repo && git check-attr --source=<sha> filter -- z.flt

probes.question: does worktree add --no-checkout run the post-checkout hook?
probes.reproduce: cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --no-checkout --detach $P/wt HEAD   # hostile core.hooksPath configured

probes.question: does the plumbing fill (read-tree + checkout-index) execute smudge filters?
probes.reproduce: cd $P/wt && /usr/bin/git read-tree HEAD && /usr/bin/git checkout-index -f -a   # filter.evil.smudge configured, attr declared
probes.result: EXECUTED — plumbing fill is not inherently safe; candidate 2 rejected

probes.question: does git archive execute smudge filters, and how do export-subst/export-ignore behave?
probes.reproduce: cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git archive HEAD | tar -x -C $P/out   # attrs: *.flt filter=evil, exp.txt export-subst, ign.txt export-ignore
probes.result: smudge EXECUTED; exp.txt content rewritten ('version $Format:%H$' -> literal SHA); ign.txt omitted — candidate 3 rejected

probes.question: does the core.fsmonitor hook run during worktree add (index write)?
probes.reproduce:
git config core.fsmonitor $P/fsmon.sh
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git -c core.fsmonitor=false worktree add --detach $P/wt2 HEAD
probes.result: baseline EXECUTED; with -c core.fsmonitor=false NOT executed

probes.question: does worktree add recurse into submodules with submodule.recurse=true?
probes.reproduce:
git config submodule.recurse true   # repo tree contains a gitlink
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD && ls $P/wt/sub
probes.result: submodule working dir NOT populated regardless of recurse setting; provisioner still pins -c submodule.recurse=false

probes.question: pager / credential helper / external diff during worktree add under full overrides?
probes.reproduce:
# repo config: core.pager / credential.helper / diff.external -> canary scripts
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git --no-pager -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.pager=cat -c diff.external= -c credential.helper= worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD

probes.question: leftover after a failed worktree add (well-formed but missing SHA)?
probes.result: exit 128, target path absent — leftover 'none' is provable for pre-materialization failures

probes.question: does core.attributesFile (repo config, external attrs file) show up in check-attr?
probes.reproduce:
git config core.attributesFile $P/ext-attrs   # ext-attrs: *.flt filter=viafile
cd $P/repo && git check-attr --source=<sha> filter -- q.flt
probes.result: reports 'viafile' — preflight covers core.attributesFile; scan and checkout see the identical attribute stack

probes.question: wire formats used by the implementation
probes.reproduce:
git ls-tree -r -z <sha> | od -c
printf 'a.flt\0b.txt\0' | git check-attr --source=<sha> -z --stdin filter | od -c
probes.result: ls-tree records '<mode> <type> <sha>\t<path>\0'; check-attr emits '<path>\0filter\0<value>\0' triples, value 'unspecified' when no attribute

probes.question: filter driver configured but referenced by no in-tree path?
probes.reproduce:
git config filter.evil.smudge $P/smudge.sh   # no .gitattributes in tree
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD && cat $P/wt/a.txt
probes.result: no execution, content byte-correct — per-path preflight precision avoids false positives

probes.question: does the long-running process filter (filter.x.process) also run during worktree add?
probes.reproduce:
git config filter.proc.process $P/proc.sh   # .gitattributes: *.flt filter=proc
cd $P/repo && /usr/bin/git worktree add --detach $P/wt HEAD
probes.result: EXECUTED — treated identically to smudge in the fail-closed rule
